_doc.general: Section read by scripts/check-traceability.py. Whatever is missing takes these same defaults: dictionaries are merged key by key, a list replaces the default one entirely and a type set to null is removed. Keys starting with «_» are ignored. Paths are relative to the project root (--project). The environment inventory is read from environment.inventory (written by check-environment.py).
_doc.paths.specs: Glob or list of globs of the specs. From each one the requirements are read up to spec.requirements_end; the AC are checked against the union of all of them.
_doc.paths.traceability: The AC → step → verification table, with its sections for exclusions and for steps without AC.
_doc.paths.steps: Glob or list of globs of the step files of the delivery plan («### W1.1 — …»).
_doc.paths.integration: integration.md, with the scopes table. Optional: only --graph uses it; without it, the scopes are not checked.
_doc.paths.status: status.md, with the «Steps» table. Optional: it is only used to warn about rows in the initial state whose steps are already integrated.
_doc.paths.step_reports: Folder of the step reports, one per step: <step_reports>/<step>.md.
_doc.paths.prior_validations: File of the prior validations (the validation wave). Optional: if it does not exist, it is not an error.
_doc.paths.demo_walkthrough: Demo walkthrough, where the closing step consolidates the demo steps. Optional.
_doc.paths.reviews: Folder of the review reports, in subfolders <date>-<step>/.
_doc.paths.exclude: Folder names that are never read as evidence (e.g. node_modules).
_doc.ids.requirement: Regular expression of a requirement ID.
_doc.ids.ac: Regular expression of an AC ID, with the groups (?P<req>…) and (?P<num>…) at the top level. The short form of a list («AC-PED-02.1 to 02.3, 02.5») is what runs from (?P<req>; «to» or «–» make a range within the same req.
_doc.ids.step: Regular expression of a step ID, with (?P<num>…), the number a range runs through («W1.1-W1.4»), and, if there are waves, (?P<wave>…). A range cannot change anything other than num.
_doc.ids.step_example: How a step is written in help messages.
_doc.ids.external_dependency: Regular expression of an external dependency in «Depends on» (an open question or blocker); the size rule uses it. null to skip the check.
_doc.spec.requirements_end: Text that closes the requirements part of the spec; what follows (the design) is not read. null to read the whole spec.
_doc.spec.priority: Regular expression of the priority of a requirement, with one group (the priority).
_doc.spec.critical_priority: Priority whose exclusion is a warning.
_doc.fields: Names of the fields of a step, as written in «- **<name>:**». depends: dependencies («to close: …» are the finish-to-finish ones); satisfies: the AC or requirements it satisfies; test_first: «Test first», with the test classes between backticks; parallel: «Parallel with»; size: the size; skill: the execution skills, between backticks.
_doc.sections.exclusions: Heading (starts with) of the exclusions section of traceability.md.
_doc.sections.steps_without_ac: Heading (starts with) of the steps-without-AC section of traceability.md.
_doc.sections.report_cases: Exact heading of the section of a step report where AC citations count.
_doc.sections.scopes: Heading (starts with) of the section of integration.md with the scopes table.
_doc.markers.to_close: In «Depends on», the segment containing this text holds finish-to-finish dependencies.
_doc.markers.except: In «Satisfies», «R-XX (except AC-…)» subtracts those AC from the requirement.
_doc.markers.satisfies_end: In «Satisfies», whatever follows any of these texts is not read as satisfied.
_doc.verifications: Closed vocabulary of the «Verification» column of traceability.md: each label is a regular expression that has to match in full, and its type says where the AC citation is looked for. If the label has a group, that group is the step that builds it.
_doc.types: Evidence types. mode «classes»: the source files; if the step field names classes (names expression, with one group), only those; with: how it is named in warnings. mode «sources»: any source file; where: how it is named in errors. mode «report»: the step report, only under sections.report_cases; closing: true if the closing step also consolidates it in the demo walkthrough. mode «review»: the .md files of reviews/<date>-<step>/ (with --no-review, a missing one is a warning). mode «validations»: the prior validations file.
_doc.demo_closing_step: Step that consolidates the demo steps in the demo walkthrough (e.g. "W4.2"); with --step <that step>, each AC with a closing type has to be cited in the walkthrough. null if there is none.
_doc.negation.phrases: A line with any of these phrases (as words, case-insensitive) does not count as a citation.
_doc.negation.marks: A line with any of these marks (as words, case-sensitive) does not count as a citation.
_doc.evidence_states: Valid states of the «Evidence state» column (the cell starts with one). The first one is the initial state.
_doc.status.section: Exact heading of the section of status.md with the steps table.
_doc.status.state_column: Column (from 1) with the state of the step in that table.
_doc.status.integrated: Regular expression (case-insensitive) of a state that counts the step as integrated.
_doc.status.not_integrated: Regular expression that, if it also matches, overrides the previous one («not integrated»).
_doc.sizes: Sizes of «Size» and their units for the critical path of --graph.
_doc.size_rule.per_ac: Minimum size by the number of AC of the step: from N AC, at least that size.
_doc.size_rule.external_dependency: Minimum size of a step with an external dependency. null to skip the check.
_doc.change_log.section: Exact heading (after «## ») of the section of each spec where its changes since the Design gate are recorded.
_doc.change_log.tags: Git tag patterns, in order: deltas are counted from the most recent tag of the first pattern that has any (by default, the latest release-N and, if there is none, design-approved). Each requirement or AC added, modified or removed since then needs a row naming it. Empty list to skip the check.
